    About Us 

    Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

    Your Mission

    As a Customer Data Scientist at Hawk, you're the person our customers trust to make their AML and fraud detection models actually work for them: tuned to their transaction patterns, defensible to their regulators, and provably effective in their own numbers. You sit inside the regional customer team, working directly alongside Customer Value Partners on live accounts, not behind a wall of tickets from a central data science function. Your work spans model and threshold tuning, deep analytical investigation into detection performance, and building the customer-facing narrative that shows exactly what's improved and why. You've done this in front of customers before, and you know the difference between a model that scores well in a notebook and one that survives contact with a real investigator's workload.

    Key Responsibilities

    • Tune and optimize detection models and thresholds against each customer's live transaction data, balancing detection effectiveness against false positive load, not just against a benchmark dataset.

    • Investigate detection performance deeply: dig into missed cases, alert quality, and pattern drift, and turn what you find into concrete tuning or configuration changes.

    • Translate technical findings into customer-facing insight: build the analysis that shows investigator productivity gains, false positive cost reduction, and detection effectiveness improvements in language a customer's compliance and risk leadership actually uses.

    • Sit in the room with customers directly. Present findings, defend your methodology to a customer's own data science or compliance team, and answer the hard “why did the model do this” questions live.

    • Partner closely with your regional Customer Value Partners on account strategy, informing where the model needs to change to unlock the next stage of value realization or a renewal conversation.

    • Feed patterns and findings back into Hawk's broader model and product functions, distinguishing between “this customer needs local tuning” and “this is a systemic gap worth fixing centrally.”

    • Own the regulatory defensibility of the tuning decisions you make. Document your reasoning so a customer's audit or regulator review holds up.

    • Bring rigor to how you validate model changes before they go live: backtesting, sample review, and sign-off discipline that protects the customer's compliance posture.

    Your Profile

    • 5-7 years as a data scientist in a customer-facing role, presenting analysis and defending model decisions directly to clients. This is not an internal-facing engineering or product data science background; you've sat across the table from a customer before.

    • Real experience in AML, fraud detection, or financial crime analytics is required. You understand transaction monitoring, typologies, and what a false positive actually costs an investigator, not just what one costs on a confusion matrix.

    • Strong hands-on skills in the standard data science stack (Python, SQL, and whatever ML tooling you've used in production), but your edge is judgment under ambiguity: knowing when a model change is safe to make and when it needs a human in the loop.

    • Comfortable being the technical voice in a room with a customer's risk, compliance, or data science stakeholders, and holding your own when questioned.

    • A track record of translating model performance into business value a non-technical stakeholder can act on: not just accuracy metrics, but investigator hours saved, false positive cost avoided, and cases caught.

    • Genuine comfort with ambiguity and live production systems. You're not looking for a clean offline research problem, you're looking for the “why did this alert fire on a real customer's data at 2pm today” problem.

    • An ownership mentality. You don't wait for a ticket; you notice when an account's detection performance is drifting and you go find out why.

    Bonus

    • Experience specifically in transaction monitoring or payments fraud detection at a bank, payment provider, or a vendor serving them.

    • Familiarity with explainable AI and rules-based hybrid detection approaches, since that's core to how Hawk's models work.

    Who we are:

    Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

    Our culture:

    • We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.

    • We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

    • We're a remote-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to - work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport-optional, work-from-anywhere-on-Earth kind of remote - think flexible within your country, not borderless.

    Location:

    • Remote - London, UK

    • We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed team. You can find your productive zone and work from there.

    About the Role:
    As the Partnerships Manager at Sardine, you’ll report directly to our Head of Partnerships. This is a quota-carrying role that combines growing and activating our signed partners with bringing new partners into the ecosystem. You will own a portfolio of strategic partners and drive revenue through them. Additionally, you will help lead partner recruitment efforts from inception.

    You’ll work closely with Sardine and partner-side sales teams to drive revenue, and collaborate with our Product, Sales Engineering, and Marketing teams to make sure partners are equipped to succeed. You’ll also help shape our channel strategy and position Sardine as the premier fraud and compliance platform within our partners’ customer bases.

    This is a high-impact role that will drive meaningful revenue over time and help make partnerships one of the largest channels for Sardine. You’ll work directly with the Head of Partnerships, Sales leadership, and other members of the leadership team, and play a key role in taking Sardine to the next level.

    What You’ll Be Doing:

    • Drive revenue: Own a partner portfolio and carry a quota across straight reseller, co-sell, and referral relationships, working with partner and Sardine sales teams to close deals

    • Grow across three motions: Partner with Platforms including Payments, Networks, Processors, Banking, AI Ecosystem and other players that embed Sardine, SIs and consultancies that resell, and advisory firms, data partners and VCs who refer prospects

    • Enable partners: Enable partner sales and customer support teams to effectively pitch and demo Sardine through training, material creation, and more.

    • Generate demand: Collaborate with partners to build and execute joint marketing and BDR campaigns directed at their prospects and clients.

    • Recruit and expand: Recruit, onboard, and launch new partners from outreach through first deal, and broaden the scope of signed partners over time

    • Plan and optimize: Set targets, build channel strategies, and report on performance, including product gaps and pricing considerations to optimize distribution

    • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work with Product, Sales Engineering, Marketing, and Sales to ensure Sardine is ready on partner platforms, including embedded deployments

    What You’ll Need:

    • 8+ years of partnership management or years of related experience in B2B software/SaaS, with a record of consistently exceeding quota

    • Experience managing a mix of partner types such as resellers, SIs, platform partners, and referral partners

    • Executive presence and the ability to build long-term partner relationships

    • Hands-on experience with CRM/Salesforce, reporting, and analytics

    • Strong project management, communication, and strategic thinking, with the ability to collaborate in virtual, matrixed teams

    • Avid user of Agentic AI tools to optimize performance with a lifetime learning mindset

    • Highly preferred: Background in financial services, fintech, AI or fraud and compliance software

    Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

    The Maps API team builds and maintains the applications and infrastructure responsible for creating and distributing Mapbox maps. Thousands of customers rely on our services to seamlessly handle billions of requests every day, scale in real-time to global events, and enable designers, developers, and analysts to make and share maps we’ve never dreamed of.

    Delivering maps means delivering a model of the world that’s changing all the time and needs to automatically support the world’s edge cases – writing systems, fonts, local regulations, and global boundary disputes.

    Our team maintains the highest-traffic read APIs at Mapbox and the distributed ETL pipelines used by internal and external customers to turn data into maps. We’re building new ways for people to visualize location data. Check out our Mapbox maps!

    As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow.

    What You’ll Do

    As a Software Development Engineer III on the Maps API team, you will be responsible for balancing rapid development of new mapping tools against the reliability of our services as they scale into new request volumes, markets, and use cases. In a single week on the Maps API team, you might write application code robust to a world’s worth of data, build and deploy microservices, diagnose complex system behavior as global markets drive traffic in unexpected ways, or facilitate continuous delivery at Mapbox.

    In this role, you can expect to:

    • Lead your engineering team to identify and scope out well-defined tasks.

    • Execute on the scope and be accountable for delivering on time with quality.

    • Design systems and make architectural decisions that will keep pace with the rapid growth of Mapbox’s customer base.

    • Mentor your peers through 1:1s, facilitating design and code reviews, and providing continuous guidance to foster professional growth and technical excellence.

    • Promote a culture of operational excellence by meticulously testing and monitoring our systems and code, writing documentation, and being on-call to support the health of our services.

    • Reduce technical debt, share your knowledge, and invest in your teammates’ health and happiness, while optimizing application performance and accelerating feature velocity.

    • Uphold a culture of collaboration, transparency, creativity, inclusion, and data-driven decisions.

    What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

    • 8-10+ years of experience building scalable high volume low latency backend services.

    • Proficiency with Python, NodeJS, and native AWS (CDK, ECS, Step Functions, Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, CloudFront).

    • Experience building mapping and geospatial related products.

    • Familiarity with code versioning tools, such as GitHub.

    • Able to perform independently all the development tasks, based on designs and specs.

    • Self-starter who is communication and outcomes-oriented.

    • An empirical analytical approach. You develop strong hypotheses, conduct spikes, and clearly communicate your findings.

    • A desire to share your expertise through documentation, mentorship, pairing, and both written and verbal discussion.

    • A desire to work with and lead individuals with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

    • High quality mindset -- write unit tests, proactively remedy defects and follow through to production.

    Nice to Have Traits for This Role

    • Proficiency in C++

    What We Value

    In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

    • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

    • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

    • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

    • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

    How we support you

    Our Mission:

    Scope automates the data collection that's slowing down the physical world.

    Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not.

    Dave is an inspector. Today he’s climbing through one of Europe’s biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he’ll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report.

    We’re building the AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we’re building the largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it.

    It’s a $2T market and we’re just getting started. We're growing rapidly, and already work with 7 of the top 10 companies in the space. Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX.

    We take pride in our talent density, and have assembled a best-in-class team: acquired and future founders, people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Palantir, Goldman Sachs and Flexport .

    Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures, the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with over 100 unicorns backed to date.

    About the role

    • Real product ownership. You’ll go on site with inspectors, decide what matters, design it, ship it, and see whether it worked.

    • The hard, interesting problems in AI. Field data is messy: voice notes, photos, video, half-finished sentences recorded in a chemical plant with no signal. Turning that into a report an expert will sign is a context-engineering problem nobody has solved well yet.

    • A small team that ships fast. We ship to production every day and put changes in front of inspectors within days, not quarters. Ideas go from a site visit to a live feature in a single sprint. If something doesn’t land, we learn why and iterate quickly. There are no layers of sign-off between you and the user.

    What you’ll do

    • Redesign the mobile app for how inspectors actually work: gloves on, no signal, one hand holding on

    • Build the systems that takes voice notes, photos, videos and proactively finishes reports without being annoying

    • Engineer how we feed context to AI models: how to store, fetch and select standards, reports, media, user intention

    • Evolve our workflow builder: something between Retool, Webflow and n8n for inspections

    • Design the architecture behind the product: how unstructured data flows through the system, how AI is integrated, how offline and online behaviour stay seamless, and how we keep the product simple as it becomes more powerful.

    Who you are

    • You’re deeply technical. You’re a little bit sad that AI tooling creates more distance between you and the code, and you still like knowing how things work underneath.

    • You’re a manager of one. We believe great teams are made up of highly agentic people who care more about shipping results than collecting badges.

    • You’ve got the scar tissue. You have 5+ years of experience and know which technical decisions matter, and which ones don’t.

    • You’ve shipped real applications. Ideally mobile, ideally with Expo or React Native. You care about the details that break in the real world: offline, flaky networks, error states.

    • You’re curious about AI as an engineering problem. You’re interested in getting messy real-world inputs into a model and getting something reliable back out, not just in calling an API.

    Interview process

    • An initial call with our talent team.

    • A collaborative technical exercise with an engineer, usually in Typescript or Python.

    • An Interview with a cofounder - Jonny (CEO) or Jakob (CTO).

    • Onsite Product Interview - Meeting more people on the team and getting a feel of what it would be like to work here.

    • Offer!

    Compensation and benefits

    We’re in the office five days a week, so we’ve made it a great place to be.

    • £120k–£150k base + significant equity, so you have a real stake in what you’re building

    • 33 days’ holiday (including bank holidays, which you can take at your discretion.)

    • Bupa private medical: £0 excess, pre-existing conditions covered, digital GP, plus Bupa dental

    • Fresh meal prep delivered every week, a stocked fridge, and team lunch out every Friday

    • Working late? Dinner’s on us, and so is your Uber home

    • Full visa sponsorship

    • New MacBook and whatever tools you need

    • Flexible parental leave, including adoption leave

    • Regular team events and off-sites

    About Plasma

    Plasma is building the primary account for global money.

    Money used to belong to a country. Increasingly, it belongs to a person or business moving through many countries. People and businesses now earn, spend, save, hire and invest across borders. Traditional banks cannot serve this new world.

    Our first product, Plasma One, is a global money account: a place to receive, hold, send funds in seconds, earn yield and spend with a card in the local economy.

    Underneath is the Plasma network, built from first principles for stablecoin payments. Stablecoins make dollars faster, cheaper and more reliable to move.

    The opportunity is to become where all global money lands first: where income arrives, balances grow, payments move, businesses operate, and new financial products are built.


    The Team & Our Story

    We are a global team of founders, operators and engineers, obsessed with building the best products. We work at the cutting edge of financial innovation, using stablecoins to create tools for consumers and businesses.

    We operate with trust, clarity, and ambition: own your craft, move with urgency, contribute beyond your lane, back your teammates, debate rigorously, and keep raising the bar for what great means.

    Customer Experience

    Plasma is scaling its customer-facing operations across international markets, and we’re growing the Customer Experience Team to match. You’ll join an established team and take ownership of coverage for the CET time zone, making sure our customers get great support when they need it most.

    You’ll work across the full customer journey, from first contact through to resolution. Because we’re still building out our playbook, your input will directly shape the processes, standards, and team culture as we grow. You won’t just follow the process; you’ll help refine it.

    Some flexibility in working hours & weekend shifts will be needed to support coverage and the occasional busy period. We’re looking for a hard-working self-starter who thrives in a fast-moving startup environment and is committed to the mission alongside the rest of the team.

    The role

    • Own the customer experience day-to-day: Be the first person our customers reach when something goes wrong or they need help. You will handle inbound queries across chat, email, and support tooling, and take accountability for the quality and speed of every response.

    • Be the right hand of the Ops lead: Work directly alongside the Head of Operations to build out processes, identify gaps, and support decisions as we scale the team internationally. This is not a back-office support role. You will be involved in how we think about operations.

    • Build the foundations: We are early. Many of the processes, templates, and escalation paths do not exist yet. You will create them. From response frameworks to internal guides, you will help lay the groundwork the team will rely on as we grow.

    • Support international team scaling: As we hire Ops team members in new markets, you will help onboard them, share knowledge, and maintain consistency in how we deliver for customers across regions.

    • Spot problems before they become patterns: Track issues across the customer base, flag recurring themes to Product and Engineering, and help prioritise fixes that actually move the needle for customers.

    • Work across teams: Collaborate with Compliance, KYC, and Product to make sure the customer experience is joined up, especially during onboarding and verification flows where things can go wrong quickly.

    • Represent the customer internally: Your proximity to customer feedback is valuable. Use it. Bring customer insight into internal conversations and push for improvements that matter.

    • Be Flexible with Shift Rotation: Most weeks you’ll work the normal Mon-Fri, however team members currently rotate weekend shifts which means that you may be required to work a weekend shift once every 6 weeks. You’ll then be able to take those days worked off the following week.

    The Bar

    • 1 to 3 years of experience in customer operations, customer success, or a support role, ideally within fintech, payments, or crypto. We will consider strong candidates from outside these sectors if the fit is right.

    • Someone who takes ownership. You do not wait to be told. When something is broken or missing, you fix it or flag it. You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching.

    • Clear and direct in how you communicate. You can write a helpful, professional response under pressure and explain a complex situation simply. You know the difference between being thorough and overcomplicating things.

    • Competent English Language - our team communicates in english so being competent with the language is a requirement.

    • Comfortable with ambiguity. This is an early-stage company. Processes will change, priorities will shift, and some days you will be figuring things out as you go. You see that as interesting rather than frustrating. Preferably, you have worked at a fast-paced tech company.

    • Genuinely curious about crypto. You do not need deep technical knowledge, but you need to understand the basics of how stablecoins and digital assets work and be motivated to learn more. Our customers live in this space.

    • Organised under pressure. You can manage a queue, prioritise effectively, and keep quality high when things are busy.

    • Collaborative by default. You work well with people in different functions, different time zones, and different levels of seniority. Building the team abroad means working with people you may never meet in person, and you are good at that.

    • Experience in a startup or scale-up where you had to build or rebuild processes, not just follow them.

    • Exposure to Intercom, Zendesk, Freshdesk, or similar support tooling in a live production environment.

    • Multilingual skills that could support customer communication across our international markets.

    • Du verfügst über gute Deutschkenntnisse

    • Wir bezahlen ein branchengerechtes Salär

    • Wir bieten dir gratis Training in all unseren Studios

    Who is Sonar?

    Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

    Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


    Position Description

    We are seeking a deeply technical Marketing Technology Architect / Developer to lead the data architecture, custom code development, system integrations, and infrastructure scalability of our marketing engine.

    Our day-to-day stack currently relies on Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) as our primary engine, and we are actively considering next-generation architecture like Marketing Cloud Next. However, for us, specific tool proficiency takes a backseat to a genuine passion for marketing technology, AI-driven marketing innovations, robust data architecture, and technical problem-solving.

    We value your ability to analyze complex data models, integrate APIs, write clean code, and optimize high-throughput automation pipelines over specific certifications. If you are a platform-agnostic technologist passionate about marketing tech stack mechanics and AI marketing tools, this role provides the scope and autonomy to build world-class system infrastructure.


    What you will do

    Data Architecture & Engineering

  • Operations Enablement: Prepare, clean, structure, and model marketing data for Marketing Operations teams to run campaigns, segment audiences, and manage daily operations friction-free.

  • Data Modeling: Build and optimize scalable relational database structures, data extensions, custom models, and subscriber key lifecycles for operational needs.

  • ETL & Data Pipelines: Partner with the Data Team to create automated SQL queries and ETL pipelines ingesting and transforming data warehouse datasets (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) into production-ready data extensions.

  • Governance & Hygiene: Maintain data hygiene, identity resolution, deduplication, and real-time ecosystem syncs to ensure efficiency.

    •  

    Technical Customization & Custom Development

  • Write maintainable custom platform code (e.g., AMPscript, SSJS, WSProxy) for personalization engines.

  • Develop dynamic rendering logic, interactive web forms, and secure landing pages.

  • Troubleshoot automation failures, script exceptions, and data bottlenecks.

    •  

    API & Ecosystem Integrations

  • Architect and maintain API integrations (REST, SOAP, Webhooks) connecting product apps, mobile backends, and third-party systems to the marketing platform.

  • Configure native CRM and database connectors for low-latency, real-time bidirectional sync.

  • Manage rate limits, payload efficiency, OAuth, and retry handlers.

    •  

    Platform Operations & System Health

  • Monitor runtimes, script performance, and query execution to ensure 99.9% uptime.

  • Lead security governance, permissions, business unit structuring, and privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA, CAN-SPAM).

  • Partner with DevOps and IT Security on domain authentication and deliverability infrastructure.


    • Experience and qualifications

    Core Technical Competencies

  • Advanced SQL & Database Design: Extensive experience with relational data modeling, complex joins, aggregation, and query tuning.

  • Integrations & Protocols: Strong knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, and Postman.

  • Scripting & Code: Skilled in AMPscript, SSJS, or general languages (JavaScript, Node.js, Python) applied to MarTech.

  • MarTech & AI Curiosity: Passionate about marketing architecture, event triggers, relational mapping, agentic AI, CDPs, and automated personalization.

    •  

    Experience

  • 3+ years in technical architecture, administration, or development in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) (Automation Studio, Journey Builder, Contact Builder, CloudPages, APIs, or Data Cloud/AI frameworks).

  • Practical understanding of how Predictive, Generative, and Agentic AI transform technical marketing.

  • Proven track record of evaluating and mastering new marketing platforms and technical tools.

    •  

    Key Personality Traits

  • Tech & AI Enthusiast: Actively follows MarTech, CDPs, AI automation, and data engineering trends.

  • Platform Agnostic: Uses tools and AI models adaptively to solve data and communication challenges.

  • Problem Solver: Enjoys debugging complex data issues, race conditions, integrations, and AI logic edge cases.

    Wat ga je doen?

    Als Operations & Events Stagiair(e) help je mee om onze dagelijkse vaarten soepel te laten verlopen. Je ondersteunt het Operations-team op kantoor en op de kade, met een focus op het Amsterdam Light Festival. Dit is een van de drukste periodes van het jaar. Je helpt bijvoorbeeld bij de planning, coördineert vertrekkende boten en begeleidt gasten bij het instappen. Zo zorg je er samen met je collega's voor dat alles goed verloopt en gasten een fijne ervaring hebben. Je stage is afwisselend, met een combinatie van organiseren en praktisch aanpakken.

    Wat ga je leren?

    • Helpen bij de voorbereiding en uitvoering van het Amsterdam Light Festival;

    • Ondersteunen bij de planning, roosters en administratie;

    • Gasten ontvangen, instappen begeleiden en wachtrijen op de kade coördineren;

    • Contact onderhouden met planners, duty managers, hosts, schippers en havenpartners;

    • Checklists en registraties bijhouden en operationele gegevens verwerken;

    • Meewerken aan projecten en verbeteringen binnen Operations.

    Praktisch

    • Startdatum: zo snel mogelijk;

    • Duur: 3 tot 6 maanden;

    • Type stage: meewerkstage;

    • Werktijden: Een combinatie van kantoortijden en operationele diensten. Beschikbaarheid in avonden en weekenden is vereist;

    • Stagevergoeding: € 500 per maand;

    • Locatie: kantoor in hartje Amsterdam en de kade.

    Wat we aanbieden

    • Een afwisselende meewerkstage waarin je zowel organisatorische als praktische ervaring opdoet;

    • De kans om mee te werken aan de vaarten van het Amsterdam Light Festival en een uniek kijkje achter de schermen te krijgen bij een van de grootste rondvaartoperaties van Amsterdam;

    • Een centraal gelegen kantoor op ca. 15 minuten lopen van Amsterdam Centraal;

    • Legendarische vrijdagmiddagborrels, sportieve uitjes en bedrijfsfeesten;

    • Een heerlijke verzorgde lunch op kantoor;

    • 25% personeelskorting op rondvaarten en andere activiteiten binnen Flagship Holding.

    Functievereisten

    • Een mbo-, hbo- of wo-opleiding in operations, events, hospitality, toerisme of bedrijfskunde;

    • Een betrouwbare, praktische en gastgerichte instelling;

    • Het vermogen om rustig te blijven bij drukte en flexibel omgaan met wisselende taken;

    • Goede beheersing van het Engels, kennis van het Nederlands is een pre;

    • Beschikbaar tijdens het Amsterdam Light Festival (ALF), ook in de avonden en weekenden;

    • Kennis van Excel is een plus.


    Over Flagship Amsterdam

    Flagship Amsterdam is een snelgroeiende rederij in het hart van Amsterdam. Wat in 2017 begon met drie boten, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een vloot van meer dan 70 boten, en we groeien nog steeds elke dag verder! Jaarlijks verwelkomen we gasten uit meer dan 55 verschillende landen, en we varen het hele jaar door. Dit doen we met een gedreven en ambitieus team van meer dan 800 (seizoensgebonden) medewerkers.

    Maar Flagship is meer dan alleen rondvaarten. Vanuit dezelfde energie bouwen we aan verschillende concepten die allemaal draaien om beleving, gastvrijheid en de stad Amsterdam. Zo ontdek je de stad op de fiets met Flagship Bike Tours, proef je de sfeer bij Flagship Waffle Experience Amsterdam, en werken we bij Shipyard aan creatieve projecten op en rond het water. Daarnaast hebben we labels zoals Voyage Amsterdam, Captain Jack en Aemstelland, elk met hun eigen stijl en doelgroep. Samen vormen ze één organisatie, maar met verschillende manieren om mensen de stad te laten ervaren.

    Het mooie van Univé? Dat zijn de mensen, de resultaten, de geschiedenis, de cultuur, het ontstaan en de betrokkenheid. Dat is samenwerken. Een coöperatie zijn zonder winstoogmerk. Dicht bij onze leden staan. En samen bouwen aan een organisatie die betrouwbaar, toekomstbestendig en wendbaar is.

Ons doel? Grip op uitgaven en risico’s, professionele en efficiënte processen én optimale ondersteuning van de business.

    • regie voeren op complexe, risicovolle en/of strategische contracten;

    • organiseren en leiden van leveranciersoverleggen;

    • bewaken van SLA’s, KPI’s, afspraken en verbetermaatregelen;

    • ondersteunen van contracteigenaren en management bij besluitvorming over contracten en leveranciers;

    • opstellen van analyses en managementrapportages over contractstatus, prestaties, risico’s, acties en besluitpunten;

    • tijdig signaleren wanneer hercontractering of een nieuwe marktbenadering nodig is;

    • bijdragen aan de verdere professionalisering van contract- en leveranciersmanagement binnen Univé.

    De inhoudelijke beoordeling van de dienstverlening ligt primair bij de business en contracteigenaar.     Make Your Mark as a Reliability Engineer at Storio group

    About the role.

    We are looking for a Reliability Engineer to join our production team and help optimize our machinery operations. In this role, you will analyze the lifecycle of our equipment, evaluate how we manage asset maintenance, and prevent potential downtime before it happens. You will work closely with operational teams to keep our production running safely and smoothly across our plant.

    When failures do occur, you will advise the team on how to respond quickly and effectively. You will use data and engineering risk methodologies to develop preventive maintenance strategies, establish inspection criteria, and protect our business from performance losses. Your work directly impacts our operational efficiency and the continuous delivery of personalized products to our customers.



    How you embrace curiosity daily.

    • Analyze statistical data, performance losses, and cost drivers to predict equipment failures and uncover improvement opportunities.

    • Facilitate root cause analysis using techniques like FMEA, Fault Tree Analysis, and PHA for complex machinery issues.

    • Test new ideas and support machine trials to optimize process performance and material changes.

    • Review preventive maintenance programs and recommend technical updates to increase machinery availability.

    • Assess the technical feasibility of proposed changes from procurement and operational teams.

    • Explore innovative ways to streamline maintenance approaches while cutting overall operational costs.



    How you make your mark.

    • Maximize equipment availability and reliability while lowering maintenance costs across the plant.

    • Develop effective maintenance strategies and clear standard operating procedures for autonomous maintenance.

    • Lead cross-functional improvement teams to solve persistent technical problems and boost site productivity.

    • Support capital investment projects to ensure new equipment meets strict maintainability standards and spare part requirements.

    • Conduct risk assessments to maintain full compliance with statutory inspection requirements, safety guidelines, and product quality standards.



    What you bring to the team.

    • Strong experience as a reliability engineer or production specialist in a manufacturing environment.

    • Deep knowledge of reliability engineering techniques including FMEA, FTA, PHA, and criticality analysis.

    • Proven ability to facilitate root cause analysis and resolve complex technical equipment failures.

    • Practical background in developing preventive maintenance strategies, SOPs, and machine inspection criteria.

    • Hands-on experience supporting new machine installations, engineering trials, and capital projects.

    • Strong communication skills to guide production teams and collaborate on safety and quality standards.



    What sets you apart.

    • Experience applying maintainability analysis within high-volume automated production settings.

    • Degree or formal qualification in Mechanical, Electrical, or Reliability Engineering.

  • “My listings”, “My requests”, and “Incoming requests” views.

  • Nice, minimal layout.

Roles & rules

  • Have two roles:

  • admin:

    • Can remove any listing, view all loans, and mark a lender as “Trusted Lender”.

  • user:

    • Can create, edit, and delete only their own listings, and act only on requests involving their own tools or their own borrowing.

  • Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI.

Automation with n8n

  • Build at least two n8n workflows:

  • Request notification: when a borrow request is created or changes status, Convex calls an n8n Webhook. The workflow notifies the relevant user (email, Slack, Discord, or a logged mock notification is fine) using only the fields it needs.

  • Overdue reminders: a scheduled workflow runs daily, fetches overdue loans from a Convex HTTP endpoint, sends a reminder to each borrower, and writes the reminder status back to Convex.

  • Secure the integration in both directions:

  • Sign webhook payloads (e.g. HMAC with a shared secret) and verify signatures on the receiving side.

  • Keep secrets in environment variables and n8n credentials, never in code or exported workflow JSON.

  • Make write-backs idempotent so retries do not create duplicate records or reminders.

  • Handle failures with retries and an error workflow (or equivalent) so failed runs are visible and never fail silently.

  • (Bonus) Show recent automation activity on each loan in the app, e.g. “Reminder sent 2 days ago”.

Deliverables

The future is full of possibilities. At Banner Health, we’re excited about what the future holds for health care. That’s why we’re changing the industry to make the experience the best it can be. Our team has come together with the common goal: Make health care easier, so life can be better. The future of health care starts here. If you’re ready to change lives, we want to hear from you.

We are seeking a highly strategic and results-driven Senior Strategic Sourcing Administer to lead sourcing, contract negotiation, and supplier management initiatives across high-spend clinical categories, including Cardiology, Interventional Radiology, and Imaging.


This role manages a $100M contract portfolio consisting of procurement contracts, outsourced services programs, and purchasing initiatives. The successful candidate will be responsible for maximizing organizational value while minimizing costs through effective supplier negotiations, strategic sourcing initiatives, and strong stakeholder partnerships.

This position plays a critical role in collaborating with physicians, clinical leadership, and operational leaders to develop sourcing strategies for products with a high degree of physician preference, ensuring both financial stewardship and positive patient outcomes.


Apply today to help shape the future of healthcare procurement and supply chain excellence.

Location: Remote, Banner provides equipment
Schedule: Monday-Friday, 7am - 4pm


*​This can be a remote position if you live in the following state(s) only: AZ, CA, NV, CO, NB & WY*

Within Banner Health Corporate, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique experience and expertise in support of a nationally-recognized healthcare leader. We offer stimulating and rewarding careers in a wide array of disciplines. Whether your background is in Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Managed Care Programs or Public Relations, you'll find many options for contributing to our award-winning patient care.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for a $100M contract portfolio of procurement contracts, outsourced services programs, and purchasing programs, maximizing value to the company while minimizing cost from vendors and suppliers; provides high quality procurement services to meet the needs of internal customers. The incumbent is accountable for developing efficiencies and for finding new opportunities to reduce supply cost through effective vendor negotiations, and for promoting sound and ethical contracting and purchasing practices between the company and the vendor community; and for developing and maintaining positive vendor relationships based on mutual respect and trust. This position directs and leads the overall sourcing strategy for high spend product categories with a high degree of physician preference which will require collaboration with physicians and other key clinical decision makers.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Monitors, assesses and re-bids or re-negotiates existing contracts and vendor agreements in assigned areas as appropriate every one to three years. Regularly evaluates and revises as appropriate company participation in programs such as medical supply agreements, service agreements, capital equipment agreements and pooled purchase agreements. Monitors vendor and company/facility contract compliance and performance.

2. Identifies and develops new cost savings sources and vendor agreement opportunities through market monitoring, product research, usage, source and cost analysis, and participation in hospital or assigned area procurement association and education. Conducts analysis of products, prices and usage opportunities; prepares spreadsheets and executive summaries of contracts and presents recommendations to the Supply Chain Governance Team.

3. Manages the contracting processes for assigned areas: The development of specifications, performance of due diligence work (such as research and financial analysis) the development and writing of Requests for Proposals (RFPs), and the writing and editing of contract documents. Independently reviews complex terms and conditions, develops alternative language, performs risk analysis/mitigation, and provides recommendations while ensuring compliance with legal requirements, customer requirements. Coordinates legal review of contracts as appropriate.

4. Provides enterprise leadership and consultation to company facilities in the contracting, procurement and utilization of supplies, products and equipment for assigned service lines. Uses a variety of methods to collect collaborative input of end users and purchasers, builds detail of specification, and develops group consensus. Demonstrates ability to influence and deal tactfully and confidentially with internal and external customers at all organizational levels in a dynamic environment.

5. Facilitates implementation of new procurement processes, policies, procedures and agreements. Develops and communicates work plans to all affected parties.

6. Collects, consolidates and provides contract and procurement information to senior management in the form of reports, financial analysis, supply utilization, capital expenditures, etc. as required or appropriate.

7. Monitors usage of products under Contract Management Agreements. Assures accurate vendor payments of rebates and dividends. Serves as key contact for Supplier Relationship Management and coordinates ongoing business reviews with key suppliers.

8. Provides technical and expert counsel to other staff members in matters of assigned procurement area(s).

9. Annual dollar contracting exceeds $100 million dollars. Enterprise authority for contracting. Manages contracts for equipment, supplies and services for all company facilities.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Requires the degree of skills, knowledge and ability normally demonstrated by a Bachelor’s degree in Business or a related field.

Requires seven or more years of similar purchasing experience, including capital equipment purchase, Request For Proposal development, bid analysis, contract negotiation and contracting. Requires extensive knowledge of products, procurement and contracting processes in healthcare, and demonstrated skills in the areas of planning, directing, communications, negotiations and statistical analysis. Effective organizational, communication and human relation skills are necessary, as is the ability to coordinate several projects simultaneously and effectively to meet multiple priorities. Requires the ability to travel to any company facility for meetings and product or service assessment.

Must be proficient in word processing and spreadsheet computer software applications.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience working with Lawson or similar Materials Management information systems is desirable. Supervisory experience is preferred. Certified Purchasing Manager (CPM) certification is preferred. Master's degree in Supply Chain Management preferred.

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

Job Summary
We are seeking a CRM Integration Architect to design and govern integrations between Salesforce and the broader enterprise application landscape. The role focuses on integration architecture, middleware selection, API strategy, and event-driven patterns that connect Salesforce reliably with ERP, data, marketing, and operational systems. The ideal candidate has architected Salesforce integration solutions at meaningful scale and brings deep familiarity with both Salesforce-native and enterprise middleware approaches. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define the end-to-end integration architecture for Salesforce ecosystems spanning Sales, Service, Marketing, and Industry Clouds.
  • Select and apply appropriate integration patterns including request-reply, fire-and-forget, batch, and event-driven approaches.
  • Design integrations using Salesforce-native capabilities (Platform Events, Change Data Capture, Connect, Composite APIs) alongside enterprise middleware such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Informatica.
  • Lead integration design reviews and approve technical designs across Salesforce programs.
  • Define API strategy, contract management, and versioning standards for Salesforce-related integrations.
  • Architect data synchronization patterns for high-volume integrations with ERP, billing, and operational systems.
  • Design identity and access patterns for Salesforce integrations including OAuth flows and connected app management.
  • Establish error handling, retry, and dead-letter strategies that ensure reliable integration operations.
  • Drive performance, scalability, and governor-limit management for integration-heavy Salesforce implementations, designing patterns that stay safely within platform limits even as transaction volumes grow over time.
  • Collaborate with security teams to ensure integrations meet enterprise security requirements.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
  • Produce high-quality architecture artifacts — context diagrams, sequence diagrams, decision records, and reference designs — that capture key technical decisions clearly enough to be understood months or years later.
  • Collaborate closely with vendors to evaluate and onboard integration platforms, gathering requirements, aligning on technical approach, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet both functional needs and broader engineering and operational standards.
  • Stay current with Salesforce integration capabilities and broader iPaaS evolution.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of Salesforce experience, with significant time on complex integrations.
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce APIs, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major iPaaS such as MuleSoft, Boomi, or Informatica.
  • Strong understanding of integration patterns and enterprise application architecture.
  • Experience designing data synchronization strategies with ERP and operational systems.
  • Strong understanding of identity, OAuth, and integration security.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Salesforce Certified Integration Architect credential.

Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

You will join a team co-developing a unified network security management platform from a leading cybersecurity vendor. You will be building functionality that automates and facilitates the conversion and onboarding of existing network security estate configurations within that platform.

The solution's foundation rests on several years of experience delivering large-scale migration projects that would not have been possible without specialized automation software. That expertise, together with AI-assisted development, helps the team move fast and consistently land high-quality results.

As the software keeps expanding and becoming a fully-fledged product, we're looking for another Senior Software Engineer to help build what's next. It is as much a product engineering challenge as a technical one.

Other things to know:

  • The team consists of software engineers and network security SMEs who share strong ownership of code and product quality

  • AI tools are part of the daily workflow

  • This is a backend-focused role

  • We are a distributed, fully remote team

We work on multiple interesting projects at a time, so it may happen that we'll invite you to an interview for another project if we see that your competencies and profile are well suited for it.

Your role

As a part of the project team, you will be responsible for:

  • Designing, building, and maintaining the software product and the underlying libraries

  • Building a self-service product: with actionable errors, predictable behavior, and a path a customer can complete without specialized assistance

  • Deciding what gets generalized and what gets built once - some capability is shared, some is specific, and keeping that cost curve falling is the central architectural judgment in this role

  • Owning and leading technical initiatives to successful delivery, from the design document through to release

  • Acting as the technical counterpart to the teams around you - raising dependencies early and in writing, rather than discovering them at integration time

  • Maintaining appropriate test coverage and helping shape the overall testing strategy

  • Applying AI-assisted engineering practices and setting the standard for how they are used - across the entire SDLC, not only in code generation

  • Contributing to architecture and design decisions as the solution scales in different dimensions

  • Proposing and helping ship your own ideas for improving the product, beyond your core delivery work

Do we have a match?

As a Senior Software Engineer, you must meet the following criteria:

  • Strong, 7+ years professional experience with modern Python - we run 3.14 and stay close to the latest release

  • Experience building and maintaining software products for external customers

  • Experience owning an architecture end to end, including the part where you align teams you have no authority over

  • Hands-on, everyday use of AI coding tools in your engineering workflow, with a considered view of where they earn their keep and where they do not

  • Solid testing experience and ability to pick the right testing strategy

  • Experience building and maintaining integrations or API clients

  • Experience with data modeling and transformation - parsers, intermediate representations, schema-driven conversion or similar

  • Fluency with Pydantic and with strict static typing (mypy or equivalent) as a daily discipline

  • CI/CD experience

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities are set as much by customers as by the backlog

  • Open for technical challenges and open-mindedly looking for technical solutions to business problems

  • Very good command of English (ideally C1 level) - spoken and written

Beyond the criteria above, we would appreciate the following:

  • Experience with workflow or orchestration engines (e.g. Temporal)

  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes

  • Experience with SQLAlchemy, or ORM-based data modeling more broadly

  • Experience with migration, import or ETL-style tooling

  • Experience with asynchronous Python

  • Experience with XML at scale, or grammar-based configuration parsing (e.g. TextFSM)

  • Experience with Go

  • Experience with observability tooling (e.g. OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana)

  • Experience with modern Python packaging and tooling (uv, ruff)

  • Working understanding of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, VLAN, NAT, ACL, firewalls, routing)

More reasons to join us

  • Flexible working hours and approach to work: fully remotely, in the office or hybrid

  • Professional growth supported by internal training sessions and a training budget

  • Solid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy start

  • A great atmosphere among professionals who are passionate about their work

  • The ability to change the project you work on

They are looking for an Affiliate and Influencer Program Manager who has already built and scaled affiliate programs for e-commerce brands and is ready to do it again with them. You'll design the program, set the economics, build the systems, and turn hundreds of creators and affiliates into a reliable source of sales across TikTok Shop, Amazon, and Shopify. You'll also be the coach their creators rally around, running their creator calls, supporting their success, and keeping the excitement high.

This role is half program builder and half creator coach, and it is not tied to one platform. TikTok Shop carries most of their affiliate sales today, Amazon is growing fast, and Shopify comes next. Affiliate is changing fast, and they want the person who knows what great programs have looked like so far and has a clear view of what the next great one looks like. You'll report to the CEO and have the room to build a multimillion-dollar program across every channel they sell on.

What You'll Own

  • Program design. Build one affiliate and creator program across TikTok Shop, Amazon, and Shopify, with each channel's role, economics, and tracking set deliberately, and clear tiers, commissions, and incentives.

  • Where affiliate goes next. Watch platform changes, new affiliate and creator models, and AI tools, and test them in small bets before they matter.
  • Program economics. Own sample spend, commissions, and retainers, and measure what every dollar returns in sales and margin.

  • Top affiliates. Recruit, grow, and keep the affiliates and creators who drive the most sales.
  • Content that keeps working. Get the best creator content into their paid media so it keeps selling on Amazon and Shopify.
  • Systems. Run the program on a clean CRM, documented processes, and AI-powered workflows that don't need daily hand-holding.

How Success Is Measured

  • Affiliate-driven sales growing month over month across channels.
  • Program profitability after samples, commissions, retainers, and product costs.
  • Growth in sales from their top affiliates.
  • Creators posting consistently and growing their results under your coaching.
  • A program that runs on systems, not on one person.

Requirements

Who You Are

You are a clear communicator who can build trust fast. You care about excellence, follow through, and data driven decisions. You understand affiliate marketing and know how to motivate creators without hand holding. You thrive on structure, relationships, and momentum.

80% of the workers across the globe are Deskless. As entrepreneurs, have we considered solving their problems and making them more productive?

With the majority of workers worldwide being deskless, Zinier recognizes the need for Technology Equity to improve the lives and productivity of these workers who keep the world up and running.

Job Title: Professional Education Relations Associate

Job Location: United States - Texas - Remote

Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 115,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of .

  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.

  • An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution

  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.

  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

The Opportunity

The Professional Education Relations Associate is a Remote position within the Cardiac Rhythm Management Division.

As a global leader in Cardiac Rhythm Technologies, we focus on innovative technologies that can improve the way doctors treat people with heart arrhythmias or irregular heartbeats.

The primary purpose of this role is to provide clinical and professional expertise for professional education programs. This role will contribute to the strategy and of education programs.

Using agility and creativity, the incumbent will be responsible for identifying and uncovering new training needs and gaps from sales and marketing leaders and Key Opinion Leaders physicians and allied health professionals

This role will work closely with HCPs, Professional Education program managers, and sales and marketing leaders to align initiatives that are developed, executed and measured for HCP engagement and impact.

What You'll Work On

  • Identify subject matter experts (physicians and allied professionals) for speaking and providing peer to peer training. Manage KOL relationships for professional education engagements. Manage faculty database and facilitate speaker’s bureau.

  • Develop relationships with Clinicians at all levels; Fellows, EP, Cardiologists, Electrophysiology, AHP/APP, Hospital Administration.

  • Collaborate with key internal and external stakeholders (Marketing, Sales, physicians and allied professional, etc.) to gather inputs and feedback during analysis.

  • Provide clinical and professional Subject Matter Expertise, contributing to the design and development of professional education strategies and programs.

  • Establish and maintain strong cross functional relationships with the US commercial organization at the Area and Regional leadership level.

  • Support Professional Education Manager and Professional Education team during programs or as needed with full knowledge of all Professional Education programs and faculty.

  • Ensure positive customer/trainee/trainer experience and message consistency at programs and become an expert within the designated therapy.

  • Understand and articulate all Office of Ethics and Compliance policy and procedures, and report or enforce policies when required to maintain full division compliance.

  • Partner with Fellows program for seamless handoffs.

  • Identify standardized methods to evaluate impact of education programs and to continuously improve.

  • Drive a culture of best industry practices, technologies, and tools and as appropriate apply those best practices, technologies, and tools.

  • Comply with global regulatory relations and requirements, company policy, operating procedures, processes, and task assignment.

  • Keep current on developments in the field, specifically on product/therapy knowledge, market, and industry trends.

  • Maintain budget awareness of spending to meet department goals.

  • Performs related duties, on occasion, as assigned or required.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelors Degree Science, preferably Medical Technology or Molecular Biology OR An equivalent combination of education and work experience

  • Minimum 5-7 years CRM or MedTech related experience

  • Minimum 3 years of experience interacting with KOL physicians

  • Ability to effectively communicate with external customers, Field Support, R&D, Quality, and Regulatory personnel to achieve needed results.

  • CRM Clinical Field Experience

  • Deep understanding and knowledge of CRM device therapy and Abbott’s CRM product portfolio

  • Affinity for educating others and a demonstrated ability to simplify and articulate complex topics effectively

  • Experience working with (presenting to, partnering/negotiating with) customers (payers, hospitals, and physicians), patients, professional and medical organizations

  • Insight and understanding of key KOLs within cardiovascular space

  • Functional understanding of Field and Marketing functions.

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with cross functional teams

  • Demonstrated experience successfully working across field-organizations to implement sophisticated messages and programs

  • Experience in identifying and driving operational change and excellence

  • Ability to work in highly matrixed organization and geographically diverse business environments

  • Ability to work within a team and as an individual contributor in a fast-paced, changing environment

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills – proven track record to communicate and collaborate effectively

  • Excellent computer and software skills to develop presentation/training materials

  • Strong communication and project management skills

  • Ability to resolve issues and meet project deadlines

Overview of 66degrees

66degrees is an end-to-end AI transformation partner that guides enterprises from complex business challenges to clear, quantifiable outcomes. Our company is the culmination of several successful firms, each a leader in its own right in cloud, artificial intelligence, and data. This convergence of talent and expertise is how we help businesses reach their own "inflection point," where chaotic data becomes a strategic asset, complexity becomes clarity, and AI becomes an engine for growth. Our ultimate vision is to be the catalyst for a future where every business operates as an intelligent enterprise, with autonomous systems unlocking human potential.

At 66degrees, we believe in thriving through challenges and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.

Overview of Role

66degrees’ Managed Cloud Optimization (MCO) team works with some of the largest cloud users in the world to help them transform their businesses with technology. Our Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) combine Google Cloud Platform expertise with a passion for devops methodologies to help our clients maintain, optimize, and scale their cloud implementations.

On a daily basis, our SREs work with varied and exciting customers on topics ranging from solving critical outages to designing and deploying new cloud workloads to building self-healing automation. Our SREs work with cutting-edge Google Cloud technologies like Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Anthos, BigQuery and data pipelines, as well as leading 3rd party tools like Prometheus, Datadog, and many others. Our SREs also work with languages like Python and Terraform to create automation, deploy infrastructure, and contribute to open-sourcing.

If you’re looking to continually build and apply your Google Cloud expertise to new and varied environments while acting as a key contributor to building the best Google consulting partner in the industry – let’s talk.

Responsibilities

Our ideal candidate will understand the value of teamwork. We are looking for the right fit with our rapidly growing organization and will invest in training.

We are based in Chicago, Illinois and Denver, Colorado. Remote candidates should not hesitate applying. A 66degrees’ Site Reliability Engineer’s responsibilities and duties are as follows:

  • Ensure near-zero downtime with monitoring and alerting, self-healing automation, and continuous improvement
  • Create highly automated, available and scalable systems by applying software and infrastructure principles
  • Employ and advise clients on DevOps and SRE principles and practices, covering deployment pipelines, HA, service reliability, technical debt, and operational toil for live services running at scale
  • Provide a proactive approach to our clients’ workloads, anticipating failures, automating tasks, ensuring availability, and providing a great customer experience
  • Work closely with clients, your team, and Google engineers to investigate and resolve infrastructure issues
  • Contribute to ad-hoc initiatives such as writing documentation, open-sourcing, and improving operation, making a huge impact at a rapid-growth Google Premier Partner

Qualifications

  • Minimum 3+ years of cloud and infrastructure experience, including demonstrated expertise with Linux, Windows, k8s, databases, and networking services
  • 2+ years of Google Cloud experience and related certifications strongly preferred but not required
  • Proficiency with Python required. Other programming language experience is a plus
  • Strong provisioning and configuration skills using Terraform
  • Experience with 24x7x365 monitoring, incident response, and on-call support.
  • Experience in troubleshooting that spans systems, network, and code
  • Experience determining & negotiating Error budgets, SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs with product owners
  • Demonstrate the ability to work independently and as a member of a greater team, including cross-team activities
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum, Kanban methodologies in SDLC
  • Proven experience balancing service reliability, metrics, sustainability, technical debt, and operational toil for live services running at scale
  • Strong communication skills, as this is a heavily customer-facing role
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or equivalent required

Please note, we cannot sponsor or transfer any visas, of any kind, at this time.

66degrees is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class.

AI Transparency & Disclosure

These tools augment our process, but we "Commit to Our Craft" by ensuring all final hiring decisions are made by our human Talent Team. By applying, you acknowledge the use of these technologies to help us "Win Together" in finding the best fit for our team.

Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

You will join a team co-developing a unified network security management platform from a leading cybersecurity vendor. You will be building functionality that automates and facilitates the conversion and onboarding of existing network security estate configurations within that platform.

The solution's foundation rests on several years of experience delivering large-scale migration projects that would not have been possible without specialized automation software. That expertise, together with AI-assisted development, helps the team move fast and consistently land high-quality results.

As the software keeps expanding and becoming a fully-fledged product, we're looking for another Senior Software Engineer to help build what's next. It is as much a product engineering challenge as a technical one.

Other things to know:

  • The team consists of software engineers and network security SMEs who share strong ownership of code and product quality

  • AI tools are part of the daily workflow

  • This is a backend-focused role

  • We are a distributed, fully remote team

We work on multiple interesting projects at a time, so it may happen that we'll invite you to an interview for another project if we see that your competencies and profile are well suited for it.

Your role

As a part of the project team, you will be responsible for:

  • Designing, building, and maintaining the software product and the underlying libraries

  • Building a self-service product: with actionable errors, predictable behavior, and a path a customer can complete without specialized assistance

  • Deciding what gets generalized and what gets built once - some capability is shared, some is specific, and keeping that cost curve falling is the central architectural judgment in this role

  • Owning and leading technical initiatives to successful delivery, from the design document through to release

  • Acting as the technical counterpart to the teams around you - raising dependencies early and in writing, rather than discovering them at integration time

  • Maintaining appropriate test coverage and helping shape the overall testing strategy

  • Applying AI-assisted engineering practices and setting the standard for how they are used - across the entire SDLC, not only in code generation

  • Contributing to architecture and design decisions as the solution scales in different dimensions

  • Proposing and helping ship your own ideas for improving the product, beyond your core delivery work

Do we have a match?

As a Senior Software Engineer, you must meet the following criteria:

  • Strong, 7+ years professional experience with modern Python - we run 3.14 and stay close to the latest release

  • Experience building and maintaining software products for external customers

  • Experience owning an architecture end to end, including the part where you align teams you have no authority over

  • Hands-on, everyday use of AI coding tools in your engineering workflow, with a considered view of where they earn their keep and where they do not

  • Solid testing experience and ability to pick the right testing strategy

  • Experience building and maintaining integrations or API clients

  • Experience with data modeling and transformation - parsers, intermediate representations, schema-driven conversion or similar

  • Fluency with Pydantic and with strict static typing (mypy or equivalent) as a daily discipline

  • CI/CD experience

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities are set as much by customers as by the backlog

  • Open for technical challenges and open-mindedly looking for technical solutions to business problems

  • Very good command of English (ideally C1 level) - spoken and written

Beyond the criteria above, we would appreciate the following:

  • Experience with workflow or orchestration engines (e.g. Temporal)

  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes

  • Experience with SQLAlchemy, or ORM-based data modeling more broadly

  • Experience with migration, import or ETL-style tooling

  • Experience with asynchronous Python

  • Experience with XML at scale, or grammar-based configuration parsing (e.g. TextFSM)

  • Experience with Go

  • Experience with observability tooling (e.g. OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana)

  • Experience with modern Python packaging and tooling (uv, ruff)

  • Working understanding of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, VLAN, NAT, ACL, firewalls, routing)

More reasons to join us

  • Flexible working hours and approach to work: fully remotely, in the office or hybrid

  • Professional growth supported by internal training sessions and a training budget

  • Solid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy start

  • A great atmosphere among professionals who are passionate about their work

  • The ability to change the project you work on
